title: Strategy Inc August 3, 2026 Form 8-K treasury update
excerpt: As of August 2, 2026, the balance of the USD Reserve is $4.0 billion.
summary: The Form 8-K reports 842,138 bitcoin at August 2 with USD 63.51 billion aggregate purchase cost, 1,638 bitcoin sold during July 27-August 2, 3,011,361 MSTR shares sold for USD 290.6 million net proceeds, and USD 4.0 billion in the USD reserve. It also reports USD 81.2 million of STRC repurchases and a maintained 12% STRC dividend rate, demonstrating both current liquidity support and continuing common-share dilution and preferred-financing obligations.
